intent.purpose: See only the emails that need me: people who wrote to me, platforms telling me someone is waiting, and deadlines that are mine.
intent.success: A short list of what needs a reply or an action; nothing when nothing does.

interests.focus: AI agent workflows and tools; read by the reading threads, while the Gmail thread asks its own questions.

inbox.scope: Inbox threads received since the last run, at most the last two days, outside the Promotions and Forums tabs: search_threads with query "in:inbox newer_than:2d -category:promotions -category:forums" and view THREAD_VIEW_SUMMARY.

procedure.account_identity: Establish the mailbox address from connection metadata; it must equal expected_account before any thread is listed.
procedure.read_state: search_threads only lists; it never changes read state. Judge from the latest message's sender, subject and snippet and label them as a preview. Open a thread with get_thread (MINIMAL) only when the snippet is cut before the request; get_thread changes nothing either.
procedure.item_identity: The id of the latest message in the thread; a new reply in a known thread is a new item.
procedure.pagination: Follow pageToken with pageSize 50 until the scope is exhausted or the inspection limit is reached; report which of the two ended the listing.
procedure.retrieval: For the decision model, pass each message as author = sender, published = date, url = viewUrl, text = "Subject: <subject>\n<snippet>"; labelIds stay out of the text.

selection.include: Email that needs me: a reply, an action or a deadline. Give the reason in one line.
exclude: Receipts, shipping and account notices that ask nothing of me.
Social notifications without a person waiting: likes, profile views, follower or connection suggestions, job alerts.
selection.uncertain_relevance: Omit weak matches; do not fill the allowance.
selection.evidence: Summarize only the sender, subject and snippet; label previews as previews.

coverage_threads.on_access_failure: Report the unavailable inbox; do not fall back to a browser or another route.

interests.focus: A person wrote to me personally and expects an answer or a decision.
A platform tells me a specific person is waiting for me: a new direct message, an invitation, a review or comment request, a mention.
A concrete deadline, appointment or action that is mine, such as a bill due, a form to sign or a meeting change.

test: Substantive, clearly outside the listed interests, with a concrete reason to deserve attention.
